# #6955 — Cursor driver-seat identity contract (catalog + Auto allowlist + attestation)

## ROUTING_CARD_V1
- tier: practical
- model_x_harness: gemini-3.5-flash-high × agy ACP wrapper (workspace-write, fresh dispatch worktree)
- why_this_tier: design is FROZEN in the issue (operator charter dump); this is disciplined transcription into catalog/rules/runbook + lint tests — the mechanical-code lane fits
- advisor_packet: n/a
- owned_paths: scripts/config/model_catalog.yaml, agents_extensions/shared/rules/model-assignment.md, docs/runbooks/cursor-driver.md (new), tests/ (catalog-shape lint tests)

- alternatives_considered: (1) cursor — REJECTED: writing its own seat charter + #6489 quorum overhead; (2) grok — REJECTED: agy leads pick order and grok carried three tasks today

## Evidence preamble (#M-4 — binding)
Every claim in your final report must quote raw tool output from THIS run. Acceptance outputs
will be pasted on issue #6955 by the driver — make them copy-ready.

## Context — READ FIRST, the design is frozen, do not redesign
`gh issue view 6952` (parent charter — Frozen decisions section is BINDING) and
`gh issue view 6955` (this unit's scope + acceptance). The operator already decided:
- Keep Cursor **Auto**; allowlist NOW = may resolve to `grok-4.6` or `composer-2.5`; refresh under
  the catalog's ~30-day contract; never freeze one SKU.
- Driver-of-record and single-reviewer CF require **attested `resolved_model`** (extraction
  already exists in scripts/delegate.py / scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/cursor.py — reference,
  do not rewrite).
- `cursor:auto` + `resolved_model=null` → `unattested-harness` → can NEVER be driver-of-record or
  a formal-review identity. #6489 dual-family quorum stays, unchanged, for already-authored Auto
  WORKER PRs.
- Family facts for CF checks: Cursor `composer-2.5` = Moonshot family (not native Kimi); Cursor
  `grok-4.6` = xAI via Cursor (not the native Grok seat). Same-family refusal uses the ATTESTED
  family, never the harness name.
- GUI Cursor = human supervision only; canonical driver = TUI launcher (separate child #6956 —
  NOT yours).
- Do not vendor pstack / Graphite / Benny / N-implementation arenas — state this in the docs.

## Shippable unit
ONE PR landing the identity contract:
1. `scripts/config/model_catalog.yaml`: add `orchestrator_seats.cursor` with the Auto allowlist
   (`grok-4.6`, `composer-2.5`), the attestation rule, and a note that Auto is permitted only
   inside the allowlist. Match existing catalog style/keys for the other seats (claude/codex/
   grok/agy) — read them first.
2. `agents_extensions/shared/rules/model-assignment.md`: a concise section — Cursor driver-of-
   record requires attested resolved_model; unattested Auto fail-closed; #6489 quorum unchanged
   for worker Auto PRs. (Rules are deploy-synced; edit ONLY the agents_extensions source.)
3. `docs/runbooks/cursor-driver.md` (new): the charter — driver vs GUI supervision, identity/
   attestation, allowlist refresh contract, the do-not-vendor list. Keep it tight; link #6952.
4. Tests: extend/add catalog-shape lint coverage so `lint_model_catalog.py` FAILS if
   `cursor:auto` is ever treated as a formal-review identity, and passes with the new seat.

Out of scope: the launcher (#6956), C0 (#6953), CF smoke (#6957), any change to #6489 quorum
mechanics, any second router.

### Catalog Seat Block

Added to `scripts/config/model_catalog.yaml` under `orchestrator_seats`:

```yaml
  cursor:
    model_id: auto
    effort: high
    escalate_model_id: gpt-5.6-sol
    escalate_effort: xhigh
    escalate_when: deep_single_shot_or_architecture
    auto_allowlist:
      - grok-4.6
      - composer-2.5
    attestation_rule: driver_of_record_and_cf_require_attested_resolved_model
    note: >-
      Cursor Auto orchestrator seat (parent #6952, #6955). Auto is permitted only when
      it resolves within the explicit allowlist (currently grok-4.6, composer-2.5; refresh
      under the catalog ~30-day contract without freezing a single SKU). Driver-of-record
      and formal review require an attested concrete resolved_model from the run. Unattested
      cursor:auto (resolved_model=null) is unattested-harness and cannot be driver-of-record
      or a formal-review identity (#6489 dual-family quorum remains for worker Auto PRs).
      Family attribution for CF checks uses the attested concrete model family (composer-2.5 is
      Moonshot family, grok-4.6 is xAI via Cursor). Concurrency is 1 (the driver session is the
      Cursor lane; do not dispatch --agent cursor from within the driver session).
```
